title: Quick Seared Venezuelan Beef Skewers
description: Savory and shattering, these keto-friendly Venezuelan beef skewers are perfect for a date-night dinner, featuring a marinade and a quick sear to lock in the flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover the bowl with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate the beef for at least 30 minutes to allow it to marinate.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with boiling water to prevent sticking.
Sear the beef skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the beef skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
